title: A skip link or landmarks let you go past the navigation bar
All navigation bar items work with the keyboard
Search and all filters work with the keyboard
You can fill in and submit the registration form with the keyboard
Course card buttons and table buttons (register / drop) work with the keyboard
The focus does not get stuck anywhere on the page
The focus order follows the visual order
The focus is always visible
The focused element is not hidden behind other content
The focus goes into the modal when it opens
Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the modal while it is open
Esc and the close or cancel button close the modal
The focus goes back to the button that opened the modal
VoiceOver says that a dialog opened and reads its name
note: VoiceOver reads the dialog and its title

title: Each field has a visible label and VoiceOver reads it
Required fields are marked with text or a symbol that is explained (not color only)
note: registration: required fields (name, email, student ID, program) have no asterisk or "required" text; no note that all fields are required

title: An empty or wrong submit shows each error in text next to its field
Each error message tells how to correct it
VoiceOver reads the errors after submit
note: after an empty submit the focus moves to the first required field and VoiceOver reads the browser message ("Fill out this field"), but not the field name

title: VoiceOver reads the result count after a search or filter change and the focus stays in place
note: catalog: the new result count is not read after a search, also after a pause; the count has aria-live="polite" in the code, but VoiceOver reads only the typed word

title: VoiceOver reads the confirmation after you register or drop a course
note: register: confirmation is read; profile: nothing is read after Drop (the focus stays in place)

title: Each page or view has a title that tells what it is
note: each page has its own title (Prism University | Find your color, Course Catalog | ..., Registration | ..., Student Profile | ...)

title: Headings: one h1 per view and levels in a logical order
note: catalog: h1 then course titles at h3, no h2 between (levels jump from 1 to 3)

title: Landmarks: banner or header and navigation and main and footer
note: banner, navigation, main, region, content information

title: Link and button names tell what they do
note: catalog: each course card button is named only "Add to plan" (VoiceOver: "Add to plan, button"), with no course name; links are fine; Remove and Drop buttons include the course code

title: Meaningful images and icons have a text alternative and decorative ones are hidden
note: no meaningful images; icon buttons have names that include the course (for example "Drop CS 110")

title: VoiceOver reads the column header for each cell of the registered-courses table
Dropdowns and toggles and tabs announce their role and state (for example expanded or selected)
note: dropdowns: VoiceOver reads role and state

title: The navigation bar tells which page is the current page
note: VoiceOver says "current page" on the menu item

title: At 320 px width there is no horizontal scroll and no content is lost
At 200% zoom all text is readable and nothing is cut off or on top of other content
note: also seen at 100%: catalog search icon is on top of the placeholder text; home: calendar icon is not centered in its tile (cosmetic, not counted)

title: Errors and status and selected filters are not shown by color only
Focus indicators and field borders have a contrast of at least 3:1
note: lowest 1.38:1 (computed from the CSS, not measured): field border #ded9eb on white; link focus ring rgba(107,76,255,.42) on white about 1.9:1; field focus border #9d86ff on white 2.88:1

title: The needs-review contrast sample passes (4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text)
note: Needs-review sample (worst point of the background, measured by script in headless Chromium at 1280 px, not by hand): home top bar link "Register by November 14" white 12.5px/700 on pink-purple gradient 3.81:1 (needs 4.5:1, fail); home "Browse courses" button white 13.9px/750 on gradient 3.22:1 (fail); catalog card code "BIO 150" white 21.9px/850 on teal art 1.75:1 (large text, needs 3:1, fail); home lead text #3e395d 9.93:1 (pass)
